Book signal review · first-pass mechanical backtest

215 batches. 525 crypto futures. One fee-inclusive test bed.

Every strategy section was mapped to a mechanical proxy, signalled on its own timeframe, and executed on 1-minute Binance USDT-M data with taker fees, slippage and historical funding. Signals use completed bars only; entries occur at the first 1m open after the signal bar closes.

01 · Horizon

Fees break the fast timeframes

The average 5m trade is -0.044% gross before costs and -0.144% net after. The cost stack adds about 0.100% per round trip — enough to turn a flat gross edge into a clear loss.

5m: 41 specs · 178,101,415 trades · only 1% of symbol-spec pairs positive
02 · Edge

Daily edge disappears in the broad universe

Daily specs average -0.22% net per trade, but the median symbol earns -0.680%; 21% of specs are positive, only 39% of symbol-spec pairs. The average is already negative after costs; the median symbol is weaker still.

Median daily portfolio -7.2% over 4 years · BTC 238% · fee drag 0.06%/trade
03 · Benchmark

Buy & hold is a high bar

BTC returned 238% and the equal-weight crypto basket -42% from Aug 2022 to Aug 2026. Most mechanical proxies do not beat it after costs.

Daily flow is 63% long; in a +238% BTC market, directional beta is part of the result.

Coverage map

How the 215 batch folders were classified. The dashboard never silently drops a batch.

Tested: 145 Low confidence only: 23 Excluded only: 14 No sections: 33
Coverage is intentionally conservative. A section is only “tested” if a mechanical rule could be mapped with high or medium confidence. Complex discretionary patterns, non-crypto assets and pure exit/position variants are listed with reasons instead of being silently approximated.

Excluded section reasons

The most common reasons a section was not turned into a mechanical test.

  • Portföy/kesitsel kural; tek enstrüman girişi değil.11
  • Ayrışma/sapma tanımı nedensel pivot gerektiriyor; otomatik proxy güvenilir değil.10
  • Gerekli varlık/veri türü yok (hisse/FX/endeks).9
  • Ablasyon/karşılaştırma; bağımsız giriş değil.6
  • Tanımı öznel/çok parçalı; otomatik proxy güvenilir değil.5
  • Çıkış/pozisyon varyantı; bağımsız giriş kuralı değil.4
  • Mekanik giriş kuralı otomatik eşleştirilemedi.3
  • Kripto 7/24 verisinde anlamlı seans boşluğu yok.3
  • Başlık bağımsız strateji değil.3
  • Pozisyon/risk kuralı; giriş sinyali değil.2
Low-confidence mappings are not in the main results. They are visible as “low confidence only” batch rows, with the section title and mapping status in the source catalog.

Data & execution

OHLCV data comes from D:\1mDataBinance. Higher timeframes are read from local Binance CSVs (5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, 1d); weekly bars are resampled from daily. Execution uses 1-minute OHLC, including mixed CSV/parquet months.

  • Signal timing: only completed strategy-TF bars. Entry at the first 1m open after the signal bar closes.
  • Stops / targets: checked on 1m OHLC. If stop and target touch in the same 1m bar, the stop is assumed first (conservative).
  • Exit time / signal: next 1m open after the exit bar closes.
  • One position per symbol per strategy. No pyramiding, no overlapping entries.
  • Funding: historical 8h funding from 151_M\binance_futures\funding, charged to the position side.

Cost model

Binance USDT-M taker fee 0.0005 per side and slippage 0.0002 per side. A round trip costs roughly 14 bps before funding. The dashboard reports both gross and net so the cost drag is visible.

Portfolio math

Each trade is sized at 1/525 of capital. Monthly PnL is summed across symbols and compounded. This is a conservative equal-weight deployment: idle symbols leave cash uninvested. Benchmarks are fully invested and are shown for context, not as a like-for-like comparison.

Mapping confidence

  • High: the section names an explicit indicator/pattern family and parameters could be parsed (e.g. MACD cross, RSI level, Donchian channel, Bollinger band).
  • Medium: the family is clear but the source leaves thresholds or filters implicit; a standard parameter set is used.
  • Low: only a loose keyword match; not included in the main results. These sections are listed as “low confidence only” at batch level.
  • Excluded: options, US equities, FX, Nifty, news/macro, portfolio/rotation, pure exit or position-sizing variants, and discretionary patterns (SMC, Elliott, harmonic, Wyckoff, TD sequential, divergence).
  • Duplicate rules: 274 source mappings collapse to 166 unique engine rules. The explorer marks duplicates with ×N and defaults to unique rules.

Known limitations

  • This is a first-pass mechanical proxy, not a claim of exact replication of every discretionary rule in the source book.
  • Weekly signals are generated on weekly bars resampled from daily; stops and targets are checked on 1m after entry.
  • Cross-sectional, breadth, pairs and portfolio-rotation rules are out of scope for a single-symbol engine.
  • Symbol coverage is survivorship-biased: the 525 symbols are those with 1m/1h/4h data in the local archive. 5m/15m and 1d signals are resampled from 1m/1h; new listings enter at their first available bar.
  • Universe sensitivity: an earlier 58-symbol liquid subset showed a positive daily median; broadening to the full active universe reverses that result. The 58-symbol finding was selection-driven and should not be generalized.
  • Funding is applied at 8h boundaries; small timing differences versus exchange settlement are possible.
  • New listings can produce extreme single-trade returns. The dashboard therefore ranks on median symbol net and reports symbol consistency; average net and portfolio return are shown but should be read with that caveat.
  • All fills are taker fills. Maker execution, fee rebates or lower slippage would materially improve the fast timeframes; the fee stack is the dominant result for 5m/15m/1h.
Result files: strategy_metrics.csv, dashboard_data.json, and per-symbol parquet summaries under results\summary and results\monthly.
Generated from 454 extracted strategy sections across 215 batch folders · 274 high/medium-confidence mechanical proxies · 525 Binance USDT-M symbols · fee-inclusive, 1-minute execution.
